info.name: Truroot CRM API
info.description: Complete Truroot CRM API collection grouped by module. Run Auth > Login first, then use collection variables such as leadId, employeeId, projectId, and statusId for detail/update requests.

request.description: Readiness probe. Returns 503 if dependencies are unavailable.

item.name: Auth
item.description: Authentication endpoints. Login stores tokens into the active Postman environment when returned in JSON.

request.description: Logs in and sets httpOnly cookies. Collection also stores token fields when present in response.
Refreshes auth cookies using refreshToken cookie.
Logs out and clears auth cookies.

item.name: Dashboard
item.description: Admin, employee dashboards, performance analytics, and ranking endpoints.

request.description: Admin dashboard data for selected date range.
Admin employee performance dashboard with KPI, user rows, and activity timeline.
User-wise and team-wise performance rankings based on scored lead status changes.
Dashboard for logged-in Pre Sales user.

item.name: Access Control
item.description: RBAC module catalog, role templates, and user access overrides.

request.description: Updates permissions for a role template. Role path example: ADMIN, HR, TELECALLER, SALES_AGENT.
Gets a user's effective access and overrides.
Sets custom module access for one employee.
Deletes user access overrides and restores role default access.

item.name: Employees And Teams
item.description: Employee directory, employee profiles, teams, and team membership.

request.description: Lists employees with optional search, role, team, status, and pagination.
Gets employee profile by user ID.
Creates employee with role, team, shift, salary, and optional permissions.
Updates employee fields such as role, designation, team, shift, salary, and image.
Lists teams visible to the actor.
Adds an employee to a team.

item.name: Attendance Shifts Holidays Leaves
item.description: Attendance punch flow, shift templates, holiday calendar, and leave requests.

request.description: Lists attendance rows. Supports generated absent/holiday/leave rows.
Gets today's punch status for logged-in employee.
Downloads monthly attendance PDF. Use Postman's Send and Download.
Punches in with required selfie image reference.
Manual correction for an attendance record.
Creates a shift template with working days and late rules.

item.name: Payroll Payslips Mail
item.description: Payroll settings, payroll runs, payslips, and mail test.

request.description: Creates payroll run for a month/year.
Sends a test email through configured mail settings or mock mode.

item.name: Leads
item.description: Lead list, lead details, assignment, status, follow-ups, bookings, timeline, notes, and lead-scoped tasks.

request.description: Lists active leads. Deleted leads are excluded.
Gets one lead with details, requirement, assignment, score, and related data.
Creates a lead with requirement details and optional assignments.

Assigns one lead to responsible users.
Bulk assignment or duplicate assignment flow.
Bulk updates source for selected leads.
Moves a lead to another pipeline stage/status.
Gets pipeline stages and grouped leads.
Lists follow-up leads. Use due=today for today's pending follow-ups.
Lists follow-ups assigned to logged-in Pre Sales user or field executive.

request.description: Adds a remark/note to a lead and syncs latest lead remark.

item.name: Contact Leads
item.description: Contact lead capture, interest, conversion, archive, and unarchive.

request.description: Converts contact lead into a full CRM lead.

item.name: Lead Masters And Columns
item.description: Master records for sources, statuses, lead type, requirement values, WhatsApp templates, and lead table columns.

request.description: Lists master values for category. Important categories: source, status, temperature, priority, property_type, project_configuration, project_location, project_zone, possession_timeline, lead_budget_range, carpet_area_range, project_whatsapp_template.
Creates a master value. Use manualScore for lead scoring. Use triggerAction on status values.
Creates a project WhatsApp share template. Template body is stored in description.
Deletes/deactivates a master value according to backend behavior.
Gets lead table column visibility preferences.
Updates visible columns on lead table.

item.name: Auto Assignment
item.description: Lead auto-assignment rules and auto-assignment event history.

request.description: Creates an auto-assignment rule with routing sequence, fallback users, and criteria.

item.description: Project catalog, inventory units, site visits, tracking, and bookings.

Lists leads mapped to a project.
Links a lead to a project unit.
Gets options for creating site visits.
Checks in to site visit with location.
Stops live tracking for logged-in field executive.

item.name: Tasks Calls Imports Integrations Reports Notifications
item.description: Employee tasks, call logs, import records, MagicBricks integration, reports, duplicate leads, notifications, and FCM tokens.

request.description: Creates an employee task. leadId is optional but must belong to selected employee when present.

{
  "title": "Call high priority prospects",
  "description": "Call assigned hot leads and update remarks.",
  "assignedToId": "{{employeeId}}",
  "leadId": "{{leadId}}",
  "dueAt": "2026-07-25T10:00:00.000Z",
  "priority": "High",
  "status": "Pending"
}

request.description: Updates employee task. Employees can update their own task status.
Imports leads from normalized rows. Review/link defaults can set source, status, project, Pre Sales, and field executive.

Tests MagicBricks integration using sample payload.
Public webhook endpoint for MagicBricks lead ingestion. Requires x-api-key.
Marks all notifications read for current user.
